principles: prefer regulator or exchange data when it supplies the required field
retain field-level provenance and observation date
never silently merge listings using ticker alone
cache immutable raw responses and use incremental refreshes
do not purchase or activate a provider without an explicit user decision
do not authorize scoring until coverage and stability gates pass

providers.coverage: SEC filers, including US-GAAP and IFRS XBRL facts
providers.refresh: nightly bulk plus optional incremental checks
limitations: not a global exchange fundamentals source

providers.coverage: global identifier mapping; not financial statements or prices
providers.documented_limit: with key: 25 requests/6 seconds and 100 jobs/request; without key: 25 requests/minute and 10 jobs/request

providers.coverage: advertised 70+ exchanges and 150,000+ tickers; global EOD and fundamentals products
providers.authentication: paid API token for required products
providers.documented_limit: plan-dependent; calls and product access must be captured from the subscribed plan
providers.refresh: prices daily after market close; fundamentals after reported changes
providers.cost: official pricing currently lists separate personal packages and an all-in-one option; confirm selected-plan total before purchase
limitations: license differs for personal and commercial use
coverage claims must be tested against Scout Finance symbols
provider warns data may be delayed or inaccurate

providers.coverage: advertised global prices and fundamentals; plan-dependent market access
providers.documented_limit: credit-based; free Basic advertises 8 credits/minute and 800/day; broader global/fundamental access is plan-dependent
providers.refresh: validation sample or fallback only during first pilot
providers.cost: official support lists paid tiers from Grow upward; exact endpoint entitlement must be checked before subscription
limitations: not economical to duplicate the full primary feed initially

providers.coverage: global market and fundamental endpoints with plan-dependent entitlements
providers.documented_limit: free service: 25 requests/day; premium starts with 75 requests/minute and no daily limit
providers.refresh: small validation samples only unless a paid plan is explicitly selected
providers.cost: official premium page lists 75 requests/minute at USD 49.99/month as of the review date
limitations: free tier cannot process 23,888 assets in an operational window
endpoint and exchange coverage must be sampled

selected_architecture.storage: immutable raw snapshots plus normalized field-level provenance
selected_architecture.credentials: environment variables only; never repository files

pilot_before_purchase.sampling: stratified across provider, exchange, region and identifier quality

refresh_policy.financial_statements: weekly change detection and post-filing refresh
